No Result View All Result Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us Hausa Edition Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us No Result View All Result No Result View All Result Sardaunan Dutse Nasiru Danu Wins Humanitarian Icon Award by Habeebah Basah 8 minutes ago in News Share on WhatsApp Share on Facebook Share on X Telegram The Sardaunan Dutse and Tafida Babban Daura, Alhaji Nasiru Haladu Danu, has won the Humanitarian Icon Award at the Henna Ball and Tozali People’s Awards 2026 in recognition of his sustained philanthropic interventions and humanitarian services to vulnerable Nigerians.
Danu, a renowned philanthropist and business leader, is among prominent national figures being honoured at the annual awards ceremony organised by Tozali Media Group in Abuja.
The award recognises his charitable work through the NHD Foundation, which has supported interventions in education, healthcare delivery, poverty alleviation, youth empowerment and emergency relief for distressed communities.
Through the foundation, Danu has funded and supported programmes aimed at improving the welfare of vulnerable people and providing assistance to communities facing hardship.
His humanitarian activities have reached beneficiaries across different states, religious backgrounds and social classes, according to the account of his philanthropic work provided by the organisers.
The Tozali People’s Awards was established to celebrate individuals and institutions whose contributions have advanced leadership, public service, business innovation, philanthropy and community development in Nigeria.
This year’s edition recognises outstanding contributions across several sectors, including governance, humanitarian service, entrepreneurship, security, women’s empowerment and national development.
Other prominent personalities slated for recognition at the ceremony include former First Lady, Hajiya Turai Umar Yar’Adua; the Ooni of Ife, Oba Adeyeye Enitan Ogunwusi; Zamfara State Governor, Dauda Lawal; Taraba State Governor, Agbu Kefas; Minister of Defence, General Christopher Gwabin Musa (retd.); and Hon. Abdussamad Dasuki.
Danu’s recognition places his philanthropic interventions among the contributions being celebrated at the event, particularly efforts directed at supporting vulnerable Nigerians through charitable programmes and community-focused initiatives.
The annual awards bring together personalities from public service, business, traditional institutions and other sectors to recognise their contributions to Nigeria’s development.
